explication: obsidian-wiki is an agent-guided knowledge system: an agent uses Markdown skills to capture and maintain knowledge in a local Obsidian vault, then retrieves connected knowledge and session context. The Python package provides CLI, API, and optional remote-server access; the browser extension adds web capture and form filling. The graph preserves these documented product branches, but sampled excerpts do not establish the detailed wiring for most skill-driven workflows, so those links are kept at the documented agent-to-skill boundary.
